text: Testing plays a key role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, like individual functions, while integration tests make sure different parts work together correctly. Many developers use test-driven development, or TDD, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think clearly about what the code should do. Tests also give developers confidence. When they change or add code, they can run the tests again to see if anything breaks. Without testing, it is easy to miss bugs, and fixing problems later usually takes more time and effort.
